content.bridge_context: Introduction to Algebraic thinking - solving for a variable (the 'Unknown').

units.title: Variables and Constants
units.explanation: A variable (like x, y) can take different values. A constant (like 5, 10) has a fixed value.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify the variable in 'x + 5 = 10'. / 'x + 5 = 10' में चर (variable) की पहचान करें।

units.title: What is an Equation?
units.explanation: An equation is a condition on a variable. It says two expressions are equal.
units.dual_language_instruction: Write an equation for 'a number plus 2 is 8'. / 'एक संख्या में 2 जोड़ने पर 8 आता है' के लिए समीकरण लिखें।
